localBiteReport: Reports from the week of September 18–24 out of Destin (Capt. Adam Schroeder, Ignite The Bite Charters) describe the inshore bite around Choctawhatchee Bay as one of the best of the year, driven by a sudden abundance of bait that has activated redfish, flounder, and trout. Both bull reds and slot-sized redfish are biting well around the Destin bridges on an outgoing tide, with live croakers and spot minnows the top offerings for larger fish. Flounder are mixed in with the bridge and structure bite, and trout are also responding to the improved bait conditions. Water temperature as of today (September 28) is 85°F. Early fall conditions appear to be kicking in, with bait schools easier to locate each morning and fish behavior becoming more predictable around tidal movement.
